floater.name: workspace_switch
floater.title: Workspaces & layouts
floater.string: Double-click an entry or choose Switch. Workspaces arrange windows; layouts arrange the viewport and bars.
Workspaces and layouts are available after login.
Finish Preferences with OK or Cancel before switching or saving.
This saved entry could not be applied. Check it in Preferences.
Saved “[NAME]”. Preferences and this switcher were excluded.
Wait for Inventory to load before saving its folders. Your existing workspaces were kept.
Close some extra Inventory windows before saving. Maximum: 16 additional windows.
That name is already used. Choose a new name, or replace the workspace in Preferences.
Use up to 64 letters, numbers, spaces, dashes, underscores or periods. Maximum: 32 workspaces.
The workspace could not be saved. Check your saved definitions in Preferences.
floater.text: Switch your saved arrangement. Mark favorites to keep them at the top of this list.
